title: French Chicken Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make French-inspired chicken wrap recipe. This dish is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Slice the chicken into thin strips.
In a small bowl, mix together the honey mustard sauce and chopped thyme.
Place the wrap on a flat surface and spread the honey mustard sauce mixture evenly over the wrap.
Arrange the sliced chicken, lettuce, tomato, and red onion on the wrap.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
